title: How a profile's company list is resolved {{green:per run}} (all UI-managed)
headSub: Reuses the two-layer config merge (ADR-062) and the per-run effective_config already used for search.* and scoring.*. The user only ever touches the Settings UI.

takeaway.text: No config-file edits: the Settings UI writes the per-profile override, which rides the same merge path as every other setting; only the factory's input changes from {{red:deps-time}} to {{green:per-run}}.
